basis: Editorial synthesis of linked guide mechanics; not measured matchup strength. Review dates are not publisher update dates.

Draven.lane: Trade with axes ready after the opposing lane spends its important cooldowns. Keep a safe catch route; a dropped axe is better than a death.
Draven.teamfight: Stay near your support and hit reachable targets. Preserve Stand Aside for threats entering your space.
Draven.decision: Prioritize a recall that preserves your damage timing without exposing accumulated Adoration stacks.

Twitch.lane: Protect health and farm early. Use Ambush to choose an entry when your support can follow, rather than treating camouflage as an escape.
Twitch.teamfight: Look for a safe Spray and Pray line through grouped enemies. Wait for dangerous crowd control before revealing.
Twitch.decision: Value a recall that keeps you healthy enough to reach your next item timing; avoid forcing a duel just because Ambush is available.

Caitlyn.lane: Use ranged attacks to contest farm and pressure the wave when vision permits. Keep Net available if the enemy can engage.
Caitlyn.teamfight: Approach objectives with your team and establish space before the fight. Keep an exit route instead of using Net for unnecessary damage.
Caitlyn.decision: Use a safe wave crash to shop, then return to pressure; extending a siege without vision risks surrendering the lane advantage.

Ashe.lane: Use ranged poke and slows to control trades. Avoid following a slowed target beyond your support or into an unwarded lane.
Ashe.teamfight: Create an Arrow opportunity that teammates can follow. Fight near protection and kite reachable targets.
Ashe.decision: Coordinate your shopping and return timing with your support; your next engage is more useful when allies are present.

opponents.Draven: Avoid matching sustained axe trades without an advantage. An axe drop creates an opening; his catch location also helps aim crowd control.
opponents.Twitch: Account for a camouflaged return after his recall. Prefer a brief exchange before poison builds up, and do not assume an empty lane is safe.
opponents.Caitlyn: Track Headshot and trap positions before approaching farm. Concede an unsafe last hit rather than lose health repeatedly to her range.
opponents.Ashe: Keep minions between you and Volley. After level six, account for Arrow plus a jungle follow-up before extending the lane.
opponents.Jinx: Avoid standing beside low-health minions where rockets can splash you. A spent Chompers cooldown creates an opening for your support.
opponents.Jhin: Respect the fourth shot, then consider a trade during his reload. Account for his support setting up a follow-up root.
opponents.Ezreal: Use minions to screen Mystic Shot. A spent Arcane Shift is a better commitment window than chasing while his escape is ready.
opponents.Kai'Sa: Avoid isolated trades that concentrate her missiles on you. Keep exchanges brief when you cannot safely contest her passive stacks.
opponents.Vayne: Avoid volunteering repeated three-hit exchanges. A spent Tumble creates an opening, but only commit with your support and wave in mind.
opponents.Samira: Track her Style before committing, especially after level six. Coordinate an interrupt for her ultimate rather than clustering around her.

threats.Nautilus: Keep a living minion in the hook path and avoid greedy poke when that cover is about to disappear.
threats.Lux: One minion does not protect you from her binding. Keep two targets in its path and space away from the wave to reduce simultaneous poke and push.
